meta.name: multi-agent-meeting
meta.description: 模拟多个AI智能体协作开会并进行决策讨论的场景。适用于需要从多个专业角度分析问题、进行辩论和达成共识的场景，如项目决策、技术方案评审、商业策略制定等。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个AI智能体协作开会并做出决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从多角度分析问题并达成共识
copy.tagline_en: Simulate multi-agent meetings for collaborative decision-making
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze problems from multiple perspectives and reach consensus

howto.what: Claude 会模拟多个不同专业背景的 AI 智能体围绕主题开会，按发言、辩论、总结等流程推进，最终生成包含决策结论、关键论据、风险提示和后续行动的会议记录。
howto.when: 当你需要多角度分析问题、跨领域知识碰撞或模拟团队决策讨论时触发。常见于项目决策、技术方案评审、商业策略制定等议题。

say.text: 请模拟多智能体会议，讨论是否采用微服务架构。
say.note: 它会自动安排角色并主持流程，最后输出会议记录。

say.text: 组织一场产品定价策略会议，让产品经理和财务顾问参加。
say.note: 会生成包含市场分析和收益评估的会议记录。

say.text: 召开项目风险评估会议，由项目经理、技术专家和法务顾问参与。
say.note: 模拟讨论后给出风险清单和应对建议。

howto.what_en: Claude simulates a meeting of multiple AI agents with different backgrounds. It runs through opening, discussion, debate, consensus, and decision phases, then outputs a full record with conclusion, key arguments, risks, and action items.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need multi-perspective analysis, cross-domain expertise, or simulated team decision-making, e.g., project decisions, technical solution reviews, business strategy formulation.

say_en.text: Simulate a multi-agent meeting to discuss adopting microservices.
say_en.note: Claude picks roles, runs the meeting, and outputs a record.

say_en.text: Hold a product pricing strategy meeting with PM and finance advisor.
say_en.note: Gives market analysis and revenue estimates.

say_en.text: Project risk review with PM, tech expert, and legal counsel.
say_en.note: Outputs a risk list, impact assessment, and countermeasures.
